packageRules.description: openapi-generator boilerplate CI files (regeneration overwrites them, and this repo's CI does not run them)
Published Python clients: refresh uv.lock only; raising a dependency floor in pyproject.toml is a deliberate generator change (ADR 0004)
Published Go modules: a require bump raises every consumer's minimum, so it waits for approval on the Dependency Dashboard (ADR 0004)
regenerate_ts.py devDependency ranges land in the same PR as the committed clients' package.json
Hold TypeScript at 6.x until typescript-eslint supports 7 (typescript-eslint#10940)
regenerate_go.py GO_VERSION is the generated modules' go directive (consumers' minimum Go): every change waits for approval

customManagers.description: regenerate_ts.py writes the TypeScript clients' devDependencies; regeneration overwrites bumps made only in a client's package.json
regenerate_go.py GO_VERSION sets the go directive of every generated go.mod; tracked as an exact major.minor so new Go minors are proposed
